title: The Door in the Crosswalk Light

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Her loafer skids on the sidewalk paint as she cuts the corner by the shopping street.
Just ahead, the morning sun strikes the glass of a shuttered flower shop.
For one bright second, the reflection is not the street at all, but a deep green path under a violet sky.
...What?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: She jerks back too late.
Her sleeve brushes the shining window, and the surface ripples like water.
A gust of cold, sweet air spills out, carrying the scent of rain and roses.
N-no way...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Something small and luminous tumbles from the wavering glass and lands in her hands.
It is a brass key wrapped in a thread of blue flame.
A key...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Ah! There you are!
A boy about her age steps halfway through the window as if climbing out of a pond.
He wears a dark cloak pinned with a silver leaf, his hair bright as wheat in sunlight.
Please don't drop that. If it touches ordinary ground, the door will root.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: Root?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: As if to answer, golden vines begin curling from the flower shop frame, threading over the brick in glittering spirals.
This is why I'm late...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Late?
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: School. Opening ceremony. First years have to be early.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: Then I owe you speed. Hand me the key.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: Aoi hesitates, fingers tightening around the warm brass.
If I do, will this... close?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: If you don't, my forest may pour into your town by noon.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: Behind him, through the shining gap, she sees towering lilies bigger than umbrellas and a river flashing silver through scarlet grass.
It is beautiful enough to hurt.
...All right.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: She places the key in his palm.
For a moment, his hand folds over hers—cool, steady, unreal.
Thank you, Aoi.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: You know my name?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: It's stitched inside your bag. And also—
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: His smile turns sheepish as the blue flame races up the key.
—the door likes names.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: The vines recoil. The false sky folds inward like silk being gathered.
Relief loosens her shoulders at last.
So that's it...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: A bell rings in the distance.
Not the school bell.
A deep bronze note rolls out from inside the closing portal, and Rowan's face drains of color.
No. It found the breach.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: A vast shadow passes beneath the violet sky.
One enormous amber eye opens in the narrowing seam of light.
Rowan...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Don't look at it for long.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: Too late—the eye fixes on her, ancient and bright, and the key in Rowan's hand brands a single blue sigil across Aoi's wrist.
Ah—!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: The portal snaps shut.
The street returns: gray shutters, vending machine hum, distant bicycle wheels.
Only the mark remains, glowing faintly like a flower made of fire.
This... is really bad, isn't it?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: For your schedule? Yes.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: For the rest of us?
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: He looks at the sigil, then at her with sudden, solemn apology.
A little worse than that.
dialogue.speaker: Rowan

dialogue.text: Aoi stares at her wrist, then toward the road to school.
Her chest is still tight with panic—yet under it, small and strange, something else is blooming.
...Can this wait until after homeroom?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear
